body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Ubilink exhibited 63-inch Touch Screen PDP TV ''AKP-63HD3TW'' at KES 2006. This model is a joint product of Korea Ubilink and China IRTOUCH companies. It features 170 degree wide angle view, PC monitor and whiteboard functions.
